full_name: National Eye Institute Visual Function Questionnaire-25 (short form of the original 51-item version)
domains: influence of visual disability and visual symptoms on physical and mental health, plus domains oriented to tasks of daily visual performance (p10); driving subscale to be interpreted with caution (p10)
validation_method: CTT; internal consistency; test-retest; factor analysis
languages: NR (paper advises using the version translated, adapted and validated for the Colombian context)
target_population: adults >18 years with low vision (guideline recommendation)
notes: guideline summary only: adequate psychometric properties, good internal consistency, adequate test-retest stability, construct and content validity appropriate in several studies (refs 77-86), sensitive to change (p10); original has 51 items and short one 25 (p10); 'considered the standard of reference' (p10); quality of evidence high, strong recommendation (p10); page 10; no figures reported
